verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's first-party docs cover both parts of the story. `screenshot_full_page=true` returns a full-page image, and `screenshot_selector` returns a screenshot of an area targeted by a CSS selector; by default the screenshot captures the viewport. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the screenshot features work as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture a screenshot of a full page or a specific selected area

citations.quote: By default it captures the viewport; use `screenshot_selector` for a CSS-scoped screenshot or `screenshot_full_page=true` for a full-page image.
screenshot_selector [string] ("") Return a screenshot of a particular area of the page, targeted by a CSS selector
